name: Ollama
tagline: Run open-source large language models locally on your machine with a single command and local API.
real_test_summary: Tested locally with quantized 7B and 8B models via CLI and localhost API. Models pull quickly, run completely offline after download, and integrate easily with local chat interfaces and scripts.
pros: Very fast setup with a single command or desktop installer
Runs offline with built-in local HTTP API for apps and editors
Supports both GPU acceleration and Apple Silicon unified memory
cons: Larger 70B+ models still demand high VRAM or unified RAM
No built-in multi-user web workspace without an external UI
